a.real.life.guy: Hugo "Owl" Guy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Owl" Guy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Hugo "Owl" Guy mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. Hugo "Owl" Guy got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 667. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Hugo "Owl" Guy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Hugo "Owl" Guy wrote a song about Hill 304. Emil Only wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-C7 and grazed Hugo "Owl" Guy's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Zeno Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak).
Hugo "Owl" Guy is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A bullet grazed Hugo "Owl" Guy's ribs at S-C7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Wendel Gers of the Hegemony (@j0seph_r0gers).
Hugo "Owl" Guy stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Hugo "Owl" Guy recovered anyway and is back at S-C7.
adammyers575: Tobias Adammyers stepped off the supply cart at S-S17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Rumour reached S-S17 that the war would be over by spring. Tobias Adammyers has heard it before. So has everyone.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Tobias Adammyers across the shin at S-S17. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Matthias "Brick" Fish of the Hegemony (@totally_geeked_fish). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Adammyers stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Tobias Adammyers before dusk. Tobias Adammyers read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Adammyers was watching at S-S17 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Roland Customs of the Hegemony (@_cs__customs_). Tobias Adammyers got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 595. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Tobias Adammyers watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
There was no room for Tobias Adammyers. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
The papers say Casimir Adammyers. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Tobias Adammyers's eyes. Nobody in S-S17 argues.
Casimir Adammyers offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
A clear shot from S-S17. Casimir Adammyers badly wounded Isidor "Tin" Bomb and slid back down below the parapet.
Casimir Adammyers counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Felix Bomb was gravely wounded.
Casimir Adammyers mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Casimir Adammyers fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Bastian Bloom was badly wounded. Casimir Adammyers ate breakfast without a word.
ben__stratto: Bram Stratto was a ferryman in Saint-Lune until the posters went up. He came to T-F4 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Stratto helped stack spare sandbags at T-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Stratto has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill is lost. Bram Stratto heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Bram Stratto put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Stratto came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Stratto received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork. After what happened at the Brickworks, Bram Stratto asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.
Bram Stratto saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home found Bram Stratto before the night shift. Bram Stratto folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet found Bram Stratto at T-F4, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Severin Kole of the Hegemony (@aleksandar.kole). A letter came for Bram Stratto with a ribbon tied around it. Bram Stratto kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.

No bed for Bram Stratto yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. The letter for Bram Stratto had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Bram Stratto dried it by the stove, page by page.
carwyn1988: Rafael Carwyn stepped off the supply cart at S-C3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C3 with the rations. Rafael Carwyn ate while listening to the revised orders.

Rafael Carwyn snores. Isidor Jeffwiratama does not. Isidor now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Carwyn is number 753 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Rafael Carwyn helped stack spare sandbags at S-C3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
A bullet went through Rafael Carwyn's sleeve at S-C3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008).
Rafael Carwyn came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Rafael Carwyn had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Arno "Tin" Ryukov was grazed.
Rafael Carwyn fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Henrik Dmt, now badly wounded.

Machine-gun fire swept S-C3. Rafael Carwyn took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls of the Hegemony (@bri3kcls). Rafael Carwyn fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Nils Noaskevitch was badly wounded.
A medic brought Rafael Carwyn half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
dc2_thelastg: The quartermaster asked Leopold Thelastg to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Leopold Thelastg reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Leopold Thelastg was missing. At dawn they saw Leopold Thelastg lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Xxcboogxx of the Concord (@xxcboogxx).
Zeno Thelastg had heard about Leopold Thelastg's courage. At V-F21, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Zeno Thelastg found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
dutch_1996: The draft reached Q-F7 on Day 9. Ulrich Dutch was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ulrich Dutch wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet went through Ulrich Dutch's sleeve at Q-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Leopold Rags of the Hegemony (@good_ol_rags). The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F7. Ulrich Dutch has learned to walk bent double.

Ulrich Dutch was hit in the hip at Q-F7. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Leopold Rags of the Hegemony (@good_ol_rags). Ulrich Dutch was hit at Q-F7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Leopold Rags of the Hegemony (@good_ol_rags).
Benedikt "Owl" Dutch came to the front because his cousin Ulrich Dutch never came home. He carries a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

A round went through the rim of Benedikt "Owl" Dutch's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Leopold Rags of the Hegemony (@good_ol_rags). Benedikt "Owl" Dutch fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Jakub Ljuliolemosl was gravely wounded. Benedikt "Owl" Dutch ate breakfast without a word.

A round came through the loophole Benedikt "Owl" Dutch was watching at Q-F7 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Florian Jimjamjom of the Hegemony (@jimjamjom_). Benedikt "Owl" Dutch was killed outright at Q-F7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Florian Jimjamjom of the Hegemony (@jimjamjom_).
The House of Dutch sent Valentin Dutch after Benedikt "Owl" Dutch. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Someone asked Valentin Dutch to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Valentin Dutch borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Bram Cowboy was badly wounded.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Valentin Dutch aimed just below it. Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud was badly wounded.
fatfrog83: Yann "Crow" Fatfrog arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-R17 with the rations. Yann "Crow" Fatfrog ate while listening to the revised orders.

Yann "Crow" Fatfrog wrote a song about Grey Mill. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Grey Mill is lost. Yann "Crow" Fatfrog heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Yann "Crow" Fatfrog was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Yann "Crow" Fatfrog tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.

A single shot from across the wire hit Yann "Crow" Fatfrog in the thigh at R-R17. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k). Yann "Crow" Fatfrog was killed on watch at R-R17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k).
The House of Fatfrog sent another. Nils Fatfrog, father of Yann "Crow" Fatfrog, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Nils Fatfrog closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Nils Fatfrog carried three men out of R-R17 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
Nils Fatfrog kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
hk16_89: The quartermaster asked Konrad "Mud" Hk to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Konrad "Mud" Hk traded a key to a house that is no longer there for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Konrad "Mud" Hk wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Konrad "Mud" Hk spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Konrad "Mud" Hk agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Konrad "Mud" Hk crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at P-F23 holds again.

The artist tried again while Konrad "Mud" Hk read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Konrad "Mud" Hk. Konrad "Mud" Hk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Konrad "Mud" Hk dreamt he was back in Kesselby, working as a railway porter. He woke up and said nothing all morning.

Konrad "Mud" Hk sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare. A letter came for Konrad "Mud" Hk with a ribbon tied around it. Konrad "Mud" Hk kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
jarkusrodan: Anselm Jarkusrodan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at N-F17 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Anselm Jarkusrodan added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Anselm Jarkusrodan sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Anselm Jarkusrodan offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Anselm Jarkusrodan found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At N-F17 they left Anselm Jarkusrodan behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Quentin Llibrecommel of the Hegemony (@llibrecommellair).
Silas Jarkusrodan joined N-F17 under the shadow of Anselm Jarkusrodan's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Silas Jarkusrodan taught Nils "Spark" Francisflute to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
jimmysparrow17: Yann Jimmysparrow stepped off the supply cart at S-F8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Yann Jimmysparrow stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel for Yann Jimmysparrow contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F8. Yann Jimmysparrow took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy).

Yann Jimmysparrow lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Yann Jimmysparrow before dusk. Yann Jimmysparrow read it twice and slept a little easier. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Yann Jimmysparrow during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
There was no room for Yann Jimmysparrow. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Gideon Jimmysparrow had heard about Yann Jimmysparrow's courage. At S-F8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Gideon Jimmysparrow. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. The new duty roster listed Gideon Jimmysparrow as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Edmund "Smokes" Rry stood up to sing louder, and Gideon Jimmysparrow fired. Edmund "Smokes" Rry was gravely wounded. The singing stopped.
Gideon Jimmysparrow taught Albin Chloe to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

The Concord sentry, Nils Zczc, shouted once. Gideon Jimmysparrow silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@zczc1317) The Concord raiders came over at S-F8 in the middle of the night. Gideon Jimmysparrow met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
Teodor Jimmysparrow put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Gideon Jimmysparrow helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Teodor Jimmysparrow. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Teodor Jimmysparrow is number 112. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Teodor Jimmysparrow wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Teodor Jimmysparrow reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato of the Concord (@cavocato).

Teodor Jimmysparrow walked back up the communication trench to S-F8, slower than before, but on his own feet. Orders assigned Teodor Jimmysparrow to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Teodor Jimmysparrow in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F8. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. A letter from home reached Teodor Jimmysparrow before dusk. Teodor Jimmysparrow read it twice and slept a little easier.
Teodor Jimmysparrow lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Teodor Jimmysparrow died waiting. The men at S-F8 have not stopped talking about it.
The House of Jimmysparrow sent Isidor Jimmysparrow after Teodor Jimmysparrow. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Isidor Jimmysparrow polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Isidor Jimmysparrow before dusk. Isidor Jimmysparrow read it twice and slept a little easier.
kevinrey007: Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey joined the replacements on Day 8. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S14 changed before the cheering ended. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey shouldered another load. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey answered to number 518. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile and Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A report called the trench satisfactory. Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey invited the author to spend a night in it before signing.
Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Silas Tadzyman came out for a cup and was grazed.
Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Benedikt Datoneperson held the mirror while Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
lucas_davis1775: Day 5: Oskar Davis reached R-F23 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Oskar Davis in the thigh at R-F23. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F23 with the rations. Oskar Davis ate while listening to the revised orders.
Oskar Davis drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Oskar Davis never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

The men at R-F23 heard Oskar Davis call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k). The bearers reached Oskar Davis at R-F23 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Gustav Karter of the Hegemony (@just_karter_k).
Anselm "Saint" Davis put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar Davis helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Anselm "Saint" Davis drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Anselm "Saint" Davis watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Anselm "Saint" Davis ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. Anselm "Saint" Davis got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 355. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Anselm "Saint" Davis stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A clear shot from R-F23. Anselm "Saint" Davis badly wounded Isidor Shitsherlock and slid back down below the parapet.
Anselm "Saint" Davis watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-F23 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Lucien Universal was grazed.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Anselm "Saint" Davis's bunk. He has named it Captain.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb, grazed. Anselm "Saint" Davis cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.

A bullet struck Anselm "Saint" Davis below the ribs at R-F23. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony (@lancegribko). Anselm "Saint" Davis was killed at R-F23 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko of the Hegemony (@lancegribko).
The papers say Teodor Davis. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Anselm "Saint" Davis's eyes. Nobody in R-F23 argues.
Asked what he will do after the war, Teodor Davis said: 'Be a printer's apprentice in Saint-Lune. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
miles.peebles: The new machine gunner is Valentin Peebles, once a bookbinder from Dunmarrow. The corporal asked if a bookbinder was any use in a trench. Valentin Peebles said he would find out.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F18. Valentin Peebles has learned to walk bent double.

Valentin Peebles did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Valentin Peebles fired back. Walter Thefreakones was grazed. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Valentin Peebles watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
On a quiet night Valentin Peebles (Concord) and Teodor Bangarang (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Across from Q-F18, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Valentin Peebles saw it. Viktor "Ash" Crab was grazed.
Valentin Peebles found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten of the Hegemony and Valentin Peebles of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Valentin Peebles was hit hard in the fight at Q-F18 before anyone could fire. The raider was Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony. Raider: Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony (@le_vigneaux).
The wound on Valentin Peebles's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
mira.dvorak.165: The sergeant gave Dietrich "Button" Dvorak a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 15 or any other.
Dietrich "Button" Dvorak reads Arno Albertljungc's letters from home out loud, because Arno never learned to read. Button leaves out the sad parts. Arno knows.
Dietrich "Button" Dvorak noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
normal_type: The quartermaster asked Felix Type to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Felix Type watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Felix Type put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Casimir Shermantank and Felix Type compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Felix Type agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The artist tried again while Felix Type read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Felix Type was hit hard in the fight at V-F8 before anyone could fire. The raider was Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak of the Hegemony. Raider: Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak of the Hegemony (@philnowak).
Felix Type tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
rachelejosiah: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he is superstitious about the number three.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

A recruit asked Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F19. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet clipped Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia's helmet at R-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll of the Hegemony (@dilloncoll2015). Dawn watch. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Severin Lagbagdotzip, grazed.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia was hit through the chest at R-F19. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl). Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F19. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Konrad Rachelejosia joined R-F19 under the shadow of Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A shell hit the latrine at R-F19. Nobody was hurt. Konrad Rachelejosia says it was the best day of the war.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F19 in the middle of the night. Konrad Rachelejosia met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Roland Rachelejosia took the same post at R-F19 where Konrad Rachelejosia stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

The cook borrowed Roland Rachelejosia's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Roland Rachelejosia is number 216. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Roland Rachelejosia looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Roland Rachelejosia was hit in the forearm at R-F19. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel).
Roland Rachelejosia no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Roland Rachelejosia cut Konrad Danhammer's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Roland Rachelejosia snores. Isidor Sperring does not. Isidor now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Roland Rachelejosia sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.

A round came through the loophole Roland Rachelejosia was watching at R-F19 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Gideon Alt of the Hegemony (@just.luke.alt). Roland Rachelejosia was hit at R-F19 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Gideon Alt of the Hegemony (@just.luke.alt).
Wendel "Saint" Rachelejosia arrived carrying the family name of Roland Rachelejosia. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
rip_van_winklle: Lucien "Ash" Winklle signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at U-F21 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Lucien "Ash" Winklle held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F21. Lucien "Ash" Winklle has learned to walk bent double.
Lucien "Ash" Winklle and Konrad Tripletonyt both swear they saw a ghost at Saint-Ash crossroads. Each says the other screamed first.
Lucien "Ash" Winklle began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Lucien "Ash" Winklle across the shin at U-F21. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Yann "Ash" Duperow of the Hegemony (@6duperow9).
Back on the fire step at U-F21. Lucien "Ash" Winklle says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Word of Lucien "Ash" Winklle's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Lucien "Ash" Winklle found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0: At the depot, Wendel "Mole" Day had practised answering to his name. At S-F10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Wendel "Mole" Day, volunteer number 74, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Wendel "Mole" Day walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Wendel "Mole" Day opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Wendel "Mole" Day kept the tin.

Wendel "Mole" Day had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Isidor Acquillae crossed it, Wendel "Mole" Day fired. Isidor Acquillae was grazed. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Wendel "Mole" Day wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Wendel "Mole" Day put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Albin Chloe, grazed.
A clear shot from S-F10. Wendel "Mole" Day gravely wounded Gustav "Tin" Jul and slid back down below the parapet.

Wendel "Mole" Day was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F10. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon).
Three days with a bandage, and Wendel "Mole" Day is back at S-F10. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Wendel "Mole" Day stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Wendel "Mole" Day was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Wendel "Mole" Day read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A round came through the loophole Wendel "Mole" Day was watching at S-F10 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Zeno Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak). Wendel "Mole" Day was killed at S-F10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Zeno Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak).
Emil Day took the same post at S-F10 where Wendel "Mole" Day stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Yann Vee and Emil Day both swear they saw a ghost at Saint-Ash crossroads. Each says the other screamed first.
Emil Day got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
At Sorrow Copse, Emil Day of the Concord and Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Emil Day of the Concord and Anselm Boxknight of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Blackwater Canal all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
A bullet hit Emil Day's belt buckle at S-F10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gustav Murilmoore of the Hegemony (@murilmoore.06).
skin09cymru: On the way to R-C5, Albin "Shadow" Cymru tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Shadow" Cymru let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home found Albin "Shadow" Cymru before the night shift. Albin "Shadow" Cymru folded it small and kept it close.

Albin "Shadow" Cymru and Walter Davebowlton found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Walter. The clerk counted the names twice. Albin "Shadow" Cymru is number 793 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Albin "Shadow" Cymru during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Ulrich Yeti of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Saint-Ash crossroads. Albin "Shadow" Cymru of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.

In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of R-C5. When Albin "Shadow" Cymru challenged it, there was nobody there. A letter from home found Albin "Shadow" Cymru before the night shift. Albin "Shadow" Cymru folded it small and kept it close.
Albin "Shadow" Cymru kept watch so that Rafael Gundam could sleep. Then Rafael kept watch so that Shadow could. Neither slept.
Albin "Shadow" Cymru pulled Rafael Gundam out of a flooded shell hole at Sorrow Copse. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Albin "Shadow" Cymru approved the method.
On dawn watch at R-C5, Albin "Shadow" Cymru fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Jonas Steini, now badly wounded.
tac_sloth_barringarms: Nobody saw Henrik Barringarms arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in Q-F1, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Henrik Barringarms stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Henrik Barringarms and Edmund Kryvolap tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Henrik Barringarms wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Henrik Barringarms was found at the bottom of the trench at Q-F1, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta). Henrik Barringarms was hit at Q-F1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta).
Felix Barringarms had heard about Henrik Barringarms's courage. At Q-F1, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Felix Barringarms tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A dog crosses no man's land at Grey Mill every night, fed by Felix Barringarms on one side and Hugo Plhubs on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.

Fresh from training, Felix Barringarms still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Felix Volta, badly wounded. Felix Barringarms fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Cyril "Crow" Ofchile was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Felix Barringarms measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

A clear shot from Q-F1. Felix Barringarms grazed Casimir Therealstycx and slid back down below the parapet. Felix Barringarms had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Edmund Combs crossed it, Felix Barringarms fired. Edmund Combs was grazed.
woobster1000: Nobody saw Karel Woobster arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in N-F12, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Karel Woobster of the Hegemony and Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Machine-gun fire swept N-F12. Karel Woobster took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet.

No bed for Karel Woobster yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter from home reached Karel Woobster before dusk. Karel Woobster read it twice and slept a little easier.
Nobody could reach Karel Woobster in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
A letter came with Casimir Woobster: "I am Karel Woobster's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Casimir Woobster tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
yaboyslydude: Nobody asked Wendel Yaboyslydude why he came. Nobody in R-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A newspaper reached Wendel Yaboyslydude with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Dawn watch. Wendel Yaboyslydude put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg, grazed.

Wendel Yaboyslydude sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Wendel Yaboyslydude read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F19 and grazed Wendel Yaboyslydude's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Wendel Yaboyslydude fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Clement Wanter, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F19. Wendel Yaboyslydude took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Wendel Yaboyslydude looked over the parapet at R-F19 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
A letter came with Tobias Yaboyslydude: "I am Wendel Yaboyslydude's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Tobias Yaboyslydude heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
A supply man offered Tobias Yaboyslydude a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias Yaboyslydude looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Yaboyslydude was watching at R-F19 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob of the Hegemony (@bobthesnob391). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Yaboyslydude answered to number 214. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Tobias Yaboyslydude watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Tobias Yaboyslydude spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Tobias Yaboyslydude healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Tobias Yaboyslydude coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Tobias Yaboyslydude tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Tobias Yaboyslydude only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F19, then nothing but pain. Raider: Benedikt Datoneperson of the Hegemony (@datoneperson01).
Tobias Yaboyslydude lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
zaboravljeninemanjic: They issued Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
First Wave. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a lucky button.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni mended a split glove with pale thread. The repair makes one finger look as though it has been promoted.

The patrol returned one at a time. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni as a story about a general. The ending was the same.

Someone in R-F12 asked Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni about Greyhallow. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. Hill 304 has been won. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Bjl answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F12 and grazed Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bram Satalik of the Concord (@jiri.satalik).
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni returned to R-F12 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Valentin Carlson of the Concord (@nicholas_carlson). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni was carried in at last. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

An orderly read the newspaper aloud in the ward. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni fell asleep halfway through the war news, which was the point. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni returned with instructions to take care. The corporal read them, looked around R-F12, and folded them carefully.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni and Dorian Austintress spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
The order named Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.

At R-F12 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni won the bet. Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz was badly wounded. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Gustav "Mud" Stefano was gravely wounded. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni ate breakfast without a word.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni and Leopold Fwtx share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
